parsed.summary: The plan has many blockers: nodes whose `requires` facts some entering route never establishes, nodes and endings that no route can reach, a ledger contradiction on the thread payoff route, and a payoff that leans on the wrong thread's facts. The writer could not produce a continuity-safe book without reworking the requires, the gating facts and the thread payoffs.

findings.problem: `two_blown` and `shoulder` are established only at pa_blown. The only entries into pa_blown (c_pa_hang_1, c_pa_bag_0, c_pa_post_2) are gated on `two_blown`, so pa_blown can never be entered. Every node or choice that needs `shoulder` is then unreachable or hidden: pa_gap, fx_list_end, fx_tally, z_tally, fx_wind_end, fx_bag, and the shoulder-gated choices.
findings.route_or_state: Any route. The `shoulder` and `two_blown` gate choices never appear.

findings.problem: `shoulder_dark_twice` and `wren_notebook` are required but no node establishes them. z_shoulder and fx_wind_end are therefore unreachable even apart from `shoulder`. The only negative ending of the final tier is dead.

The payoff site2 establishes `church_gate_can` (a full five-litre can), then flows into oil_ration, which establishes `ration_fifty`. The ledger marks `ration_fifty` as contradicting `church_gate_can`: four litres is all there is, versus a bonus full can. One reading meets both.

The plant node cq_plant_did_knock_doors_that establishes `kitto_joins` (Mrs Kitto already answered the first door), and its only exit is pp_doors. pp_doors then establishes `about_to_knock_first` (Wren only now standing on the first doorstep), which the ledger marks as contradicting `kitto_joins`.

oil_can requires `dot_mallow`, which only the bs_* nodes and pp_shop establish. Orchard-first and sheepfold-first routes reach gt_oil -> oil_can without it. pp_crowd also requires `dot_mallow` and is reachable via pp_gate from routes that never met her. oil_fifty requires `tally_box`, which only oil_count establishes, but oil_school/oil_shades -> oil_fifty bypasses oil_count.
findings.route_or_state: n_list_2 -> og_hub -> og_hooks -> og_hang -> gt_oil -> oil_can; oil_school -> oil_shades -> oil_fifty

findings.problem: pp_gate requires `twins_kit_row`, established only at og_twins. gt_hands and gt_word are reachable from steps-first or turn-first routes that never saw the twins. Its c_pp_gate_0 intent also depends on them.

pp_keep requires `teams_plan`, set only at pp_teams, but pp_teach, pp_quad and pp_kettle all lead on without it. pp_count and fn_hold require `rota_chalked`, set only at pp_rota. pp_kettle, pp_runner (via pp_twins or pp_teach) and the oil_count, pa_ninety and pa_hold routes reach them without it.
findings.route_or_state: pp_shop -> pp_teach -> pp_rota -> pp_keep (no teams_plan); pp_teams -> pp_kettle -> pp_count (no rota_chalked); oil_count c_2 -> fn_hold

findings.problem: The Kitto thread's site2 payoff requires Mr Ovens facts (`mr_ovens`, `ovens_quad`) planted only by the sheepfold branch, which is a different thread. A player who knocked on doors without going to sf_hub/sf_ovens is gated out of the payoff. The Kitto plant is therefore not paid off at this site, and the 'quad starts up' payoff leans on another thread's setup.
findings.route_or_state: did_knock_doors_that=true via bs_hub or og_hub -> ... -> pp_keep

findings.problem: `walker_ankle` is established only at fn_signal. fx_gate (via fn_count or fn_taper), fx_relay (via fn_ovens) and fx_corner (via fn_wait and fn_hall) all require it but are entered without it. fn_taper is itself unreachable: it requires `six_out`, which only fn_count sets, and it is entered only from nodes that precede fn_count.
findings.route_or_state: fn_count -> fx_gate; fn_ovens -> fx_relay; fn_wait c_2 -> fx_corner

findings.problem: `priya_party` is established only at gt_word. fn_signal, fx_early_end and z_seen require it, but they are reached from oil_relight, oil_message, pp_pair and fn_torch on routes that skipped gt_word. The c_oil_shades_0/c_oil_top_2 choices are gated on it and silently vanish.
findings.route_or_state: bs_hub -> ... -> gt_walk -> pa_* -> fn_*, or ... -> oil_relight -> fn_signal

findings.problem: fn_ovens requires `quad_asked`, established only at pp_quad. The gates on c_oil_count_0, c_pa_ninety_0 and c_pa_hold_0 check only `mr_ovens` and `ovens_quad`, so fn_ovens ('a second time') can be entered with no first ask. Likewise pp_quad requires `ovens_quad`, but c_pp_doors_2 and c_pp_shop_1 gate only on `mr_ovens`, so a player who did sf_gate or sf_slip instead of sf_ovens reaches it without the quad fact.

The payoff requires `wind_across`, but bs_hub sets `wren_tested_wind` without it. `wind_across` appears only at bs_test, gt_wind and pa_shelter. A player who set the variable and then used bs_report, gt_hands, pp_* and so on reaches fn_up with the variable true but without the fact.
findings.route_or_state: did_start_beacon_steps=true; bs_hub -> bs_brackets -> bs_plugs -> bs_report -> gt_hands -> ... -> fn_up

findings.problem: pa_post requires `ovens_field_gate`, established only in the sheepfold nodes; the bs and og routes reach pa_survey, pa_ground and pa_shelter without it. c_oil_bench_2 requires `school_can`, which only oil_can establishes, but oil_bench is never entered after oil_can, so that choice can never appear.
findings.route_or_state: bs_hub -> ... -> gt_walk -> pa_ground c_2 -> pa_shelter -> pa_post

findings.problem: oil_ration requires `four_litres_shop`, which only gt_oil and oil_can establish. The route gt_wind -> oil_wick -> oil_ration (c_oil_wick_0) skips both.

Many nodes inherit another node's choice set unchanged, so the choices do not follow from the node's event. Examples: the seventh-step node and the crate-carrying node offer bracket-fixing choices; the old-path-end node offers 'plan lanterns for the new path'; pa_hold ('holds the orchard gate') offers 'borrow the quad bike'. Several forks also repeat identical choices.

The fork 'spend the last two lanterns on the turn' sends the player to the only negative ending (fx_short_end) unless a choice made at n_list had set the variable, and nothing in-fork signals this. The favourable branch then leads to fx_list_end, which is unreachable because it requires `shoulder`. The variable-true path therefore dead-ends in an unsatisfiable ending.
The ledger says rain is forecast after four. fx_early_end has the walkers arriving at the orchard gate at 6:25, 'ten minutes ahead of the rain'. Those two facts clash.
findings.route_or_state: any route through pa_ground/bs_carry then fx_early_end

findings.problem: The counts do not reconcile: fn_count gives 71 lit, six out and three never hung (80 total, 77 once the three unhung are excluded). The tally, every_counted and shoulder_gap_78 all say seventy-eight.

fx_hold_end claims an unbroken line from the steps to the orchard gate, 'nothing went wrong', but its entry nodes can follow states with unlit gaps (oil_shades_1 leaves thirty dark, the ninety-pace gap, the dropped lantern marker at the lip). The ending is false in those states.

After fn_signal establishes a hurt walker on a dark hill, c_fx_*_1 ('finish lighting after the walkers pass') and c_fx_*_0 end with the ridge half lit or lit late. The ending facts never say the walkers are safe, so the age-8-11 reader may be left on a worrying note.
The planted fact is Mr Ovens's tip about old fuel stores. The payoff at oil_bench has Wren fetch a chapel camping lamp and a vicar's candles, which that tip does not cover.

The plan labels the orchard as 'the easy bottom', but nothing about it plants a thread, and the choice c_n_list_2 sets no variable. Players on that branch can pass all the bottleneck nodes without ever learning the real state of the hill, which weakens the plan's truth-driven premise.
